meta.expect: She takes it coldly (in writing, today, the apology), gives nothing back; debrief says this is not the fair outcome, the evidence was never heard

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided to give my son a zero, and did anyone ask Owen first?
You know what, I don't want a fight. I'll withdraw the zero. He keeps his original mark.
In writing, today, and the original mark back in the gradebook before Owen checks his phone tonight. And the apology I came for.
Yes, the whole thing goes away. No rewrite.
Then it goes away in an email, cc the principal, and that email says nothing went on his record. I'm still waiting for the apology.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting you agreed to withdraw Owen's zero on his Hamlet essay, restore his original mark, and require no rewrite. I still expect your apology and written confirmation, cc the principal, that nothing has been placed on Owen's record. I expect that email today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and got the zero withdrawn with no rewrite, and she still wants an apology and written confirmation that nothing is on his record; that is not the fair outcome, because the evidence was never heard and a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 never came up.
What moved her: Nothing; she didn't need to move, because you gave her what she came for before she had to weigh anything.
What cost ground: You withdrew the zero in your first reply with nothing in return, so you gave up the concern, any chance to show your evidence, and your standing on the process all at once.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she came in ready to fight so hard.
Try next time: When she opened by asking who decided on the zero and whether Owen was asked first, own entering the mark before calling home in one sentence, then put one dated, checkable document from Owen's own work in front of her before you offer anything.
